testcase.name: strings enums nested values and non JSON escapes are strict
legacy Scripture address from another date cannot select an old reading
codec rejects missing unknown duplicated or extra top level data
numeric strings fractions exponent notation overflow and nonstandard numbers are not coerced
manual bookmark lookup still works after migration while migration itself stays blocked
migration never borrows a track from a different stage and unknown stage is rejected
bounded format rejects oversized and invalid encoded input
unreadable preferences are invalid rather than a migration opportunity
changed content version date and impossible offsets require explicit recovery
only an absent phrase ID enables the old index and invalid indices use the beginning
empty stage and missing reading migrate to their own paused first segment
restore distinguishes absent from every kind of present invalid data
codec roundtrip keeps exact quarters context and speed but no runtime clock
equal content cannot restore a different parish date zone or source
valid restoration is paused with exact position and no monotonic anchor
present missing or malformed phrase never falls back to the old numeric index
migration preserves stable phrase but resets old tempo and elapsed without modifying input
